claims.content: Predictions of isotropic and ductile BCC HEAs lack experimental validation.
claims.evidence_span: the validity of these theoretical calculation methods to design the elastically isotropic and ductile BCC HEAs are still under debate and are lacking experimental validation

claims.content: Prior work used ab initio simulations to design elastically isotropic HEAs.
claims.evidence_span: Recently, Tian et al . ( [7] ) suggested alloy design strategies to develop elastically isotropic HEAs (TiZrNbMoV x systems) using state-of-the-art ab initio simulations

claims.content: Atomic-size diversity creates severe lattice distortion and variable interatomic distances.
claims.evidence_span: the random distribution of multiple elements with different atomic radii leads to a severely distorted lattice with variations in the interatomic distances along the crystallographic direction of the unit cells

claims.content: NbTaTiV is elastically isotropic at room temperature.
claims.evidence_span: Different from the conventional BCC alloys ( [11] ), the lattice strain evolution and measured diffraction elastic moduli indicate the elastically isotropic behavior at RT

claims.content: The BCC phase remains stable through 900 degrees C.
claims.evidence_span: The single BCC phase is stable up to 900°C, indicating the excellent phase stability at elevated temperatures

claims.content: Temperature-dependent anisotropy is weaker than in conventional metals.
claims.evidence_span: it is found that the present NbTaTiV refractory HEA indicates the lack of strong temperature-dependent elastic anisotropic deformation behavior at elevated temperatures, which is atypical elastic deformation behavior, compared to other conventional metallic materials

claims.content: Lattice distortion makes edge dislocations follow wavy paths.
claims.evidence_span: During the plastic deformation, the edge dislocation core can be deviated from their neutral dislocation planes, producing the wavy dislocation lines, which are attributed to the severe lattice distortion

claims.content: Kroner's model agrees with measured elastic data better than Voigt and Reuss models.
claims.evidence_span: the Kroner model is in the best agreement with the experimental data for all temperature ranges, as compared to the Voigt and Reuss models

claims.content: The measured elastic constants satisfy mechanical-stability criteria at all tested temperatures.
claims.evidence_span: the present alloy shows good mechanical stability in all temperature ranges

claims.content: Earlier isotropic-HEA predictions lacked experimental verification.
claims.evidence_span: However, their reported works have strongly focused on only theoretical calculations, due to the lack of experimental verifications

claims.content: Yield strength falls from 1064 MPa at room temperature to 595 MPa at 900 degrees C.
claims.evidence_span: The yield strength (σ y ) and work-hardening exponent ( N ) of the present alloy gradually decreased from 1064 MPa (RT) to 595 MPa (900°C)

claims.content: The lattice parameter increases monotonically through 900 degrees C.
claims.evidence_span: The lattice parameters of the present alloy at RT, 500°, 700°, and 900°C, which were determined by a single-peak fitting approach ( [18] ), are 3.2318, 3.2445, 3.2511, and 3.2588 Å, respectively

claims.content: Temperature-associated volume change produces a large change in C11.
claims.evidence_span: This change in volume is strongly associated with the temperature and, thus, corresponds to a relatively large change in C 11

claims.content: The universal anisotropy index of zero confirms single-crystal isotropy.
claims.evidence_span: the A U value for the NbTaTiV HEA is 0, which defines the single-crystal elastic properties to be isotropic

claims.content: First-principles elastic moduli are within 6-17% of experiment.
claims.evidence_span: The calculated elastic moduli at RT were less than the experimentally measured values by approximately −15.9, −16.6, and −6.0% for the Young’s, shear, and bulk moduli, respectively

claims.content: Machine-learning shear and bulk moduli have relative errors of 2.5% and 6%.
claims.evidence_span: The predicted shear modulus is 36.6 GPa, and the predicted bulk modulus is 146.3 GPa, giving relative errors of 2.5 and 6%, respectively

claims.content: Compositional fluctuations both strengthen the alloy and hinder edge-dislocation motion.
claims.evidence_span: This feature is induced by compositional fluctuations and, thus, leads to not only strengthening but also notable difficulty in the edge dislocation movement

claims.content: Zener and Voigt-Reuss indices indicate near-perfect room-temperature isotropy.
claims.evidence_span: the NbTaTiV refractory HEA manifests almost perfectly isotropic elastic deformation at RT ( A Z ≈ 1.2, A VR ≈ 0.0056, and VEC ≈ 4.68)
